note: Literature confirms NFU1 missense variants like p.Gly189Arg underlie milder spastic paraplegia phenotypes (SPG93) distinct from lethal infantile MMDS1.

evidence.text: Missense variants in NFU1 associate with a continuum ranging from early-onset pure to complex hereditary spastic paraplegia with slow progression.

source.title: Phenotypic continuum of NFU1‐related disorders
source.quote: NFU1 missense variants associated with a phenotype ranging from early-onset pure to complex hereditary spastic paraplegia

evidence.text: A patient harboring a compound heterozygous null and missense variant exhibited a milder phenotype characterized by slowly progressive spastic paraparesis, relapsing-remitting episodes, and long survival instead of early lethal encephalopathy.

source.title: New spastic paraplegia phenotype associated to mutation of NFU1
source.quote: We report a new NFU1 mutated patient presenting with a milder phenotype characterized by a later onset, a slowly progressive spastic paraparesis with relapsing-remitting episodes, mild cognitive impairment and a long survival.
